collection.description: A child covers their ears during a crowded feast and retreats behind a hut.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child covers their ears during a crowded feast and retreats behind a hut. Several adults assume the child is being rude.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The child returns later and enjoys a smaller gathering with a trusted friend.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They describe the pounding drums; next feast, they choose a seat farther away.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The child spends the evening carving a little boat, happy without joining the crowd.
